title: Recognize a removable discontinuity · Set 3
statement:
Find the height of the hole of $(x^2-[$a]^2)/(x-[$a])$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Cancel the shared factor away from the excluded point.
Evaluate the reduced formula at that input for the hole height.
solution: The reduced expression $x+[$a]$ has limit $2([$a])$ at the excluded point.

feedback.message: Evaluate the reduced formula at that input for the hole height.
